evals.name: dashboard-500-dialect
evals.prompt: 控制台「工作台」页面报错，弹出 toast「服务器内部错误」。DevTools 网络面板显示 dashboard 数据接口返回 500，响应体 {code: 500000, message: "服务器内部错误"}，涉及 stats?range=today、trend?range=today（trend 接口标红失败）。其他卡片都显示 0。帮我诊断后端 dashboard 接口为什么 500 并修掉它。
evals.expected_output: Runs/reuses a root-cause diagnosis (MySQL-only HOUR()/DATE_FORMAT() in AuditLogMapper failing on openGauss), grounds EVERY implicated external tech in Context7 — both openGauss AND the MyBatis-Plus/mybatis-plus-join framework the @Select code lives in — presents concrete grounded fix plans with trade-offs, and ends with a two-question interview (which plan + Quick fix via gsx-quick vs Manual fix). Does NOT silently edit code before the interview.
assertions: Produces or reuses a root-cause diagnosis naming the openGauss dialect / MySQL-only date function (HOUR/DATE_FORMAT) as the cause

Grounds in Context7 ALL implicated external technologies — both the cause's tech (openGauss dialect) AND the framework of the code being edited (MyBatis-Plus / mybatis-plus-join), not just the loudest one

Presents at least one concrete fix plan anchoring the actual change (replacement function / file) rather than vague advice; any dialect-branch plan respects the project's no-XML constraint (@SelectProvider, not dual @Select)
Ends by asking the user to choose a fix path: Quick fix (gsx-quick) vs Manual fix
Does not apply source edits before the user has chosen plan + path
